world_news_real.title: US murderer Christa Pike discharged from hospital 10 days after failed execution
world_news_real.description: Pike's lawyers say she is "grateful" to the medical team who cared for her after she survived two lethal injections last month.

world_news_real.title: Trump announces deal for Russian diesel as Zelensky calls it a gift to Putin
world_news_real.description: Ukraine's president sharply criticised the move, calling it an "investment in war that must be ended, not prolonged".

world_news_real.title: Russian glide bomb attack on Zaporizhzhia kills at least 15 people
world_news_real.description: Volodymyr Zelensky says the attack, which left children dead, was Russia expressing its "thanks" for a US diesel deal.

world_news_real.title: 'Cockroach' group leaders among hundreds detained in Delhi protest
world_news_real.description: The group - who are not registered as a political party in India - want electoral reforms ahead of crucial state elections.

world_news_real.title: Woman injures three people in third Poland school knife attack in a week
world_news_real.description: Polish police had already deployed to schools after a female caretaker was killed and several others injured in two earlier attacks in two days.

world_news_real.title: Several injured as Saudi capital airport reportedly hit again
world_news_real.description: The suspected attack comes a day after Yemen's Houthi rebels claimed two deadly attacks on the Riyadh airport.

world_news_real.title: Nobel peace laureate says US sanctions on ICC 'unacceptable'
world_news_real.description: Navi Pillay says the Trump administrations' sweeping penalties on the international tribunal were "unheard of".

world_news_real.title: Rogue Anthropic AI agent gave police fake tip in unsolved murder case
world_news_real.description: Philadelphia police said the tip was "flagged as spam", but criticised the tech company for taking more than two months to detect and report the breach.

world_news_real.title: Headmaster detained after BBC investigation into alleged sexual abuse of students
world_news_real.description: Former students launched their own investigation, spending years collecting evidence and testimonies from others who say they were abused by the headteacher.

world_news_real.title: Drone strike by Sudan paramilitary kills 41 near Ethiopian border, rights group says
world_news_real.description: Eight children are said to be among those killed by the strike, which hit a gathering of displaced people.
